meta.title: The Silent Witness
meta.subtitle: A photographer's last night
meta.description: Renowned photographer Julien Moreau is found dead in his studio. His phone holds the answers.

suspects.name: Marc Duval

victim.name: Julien Moreau

start.speaker: Sophie
start.text: I already told the police everything. What do you want?

choices.text: Tell me about your relationship with Julien

sophie_alibi.speaker: Sophie
sophie_alibi.text: I was at Café Luna until about 22:00. Then I went to the studio because Julien asked me to come.

choices.text: Can anyone at the café confirm?
Your GPS shows you were at the café at 21:30

sophie_cafe_confirm.speaker: Sophie
sophie_cafe_confirm.text: The bartender, Lucas. He knows me well. I go there every Thursday.

sophie_gps_reaction.speaker: Sophie
sophie_gps_reaction.text: Yes, I was there. I arrived around 21:15 and left after 22:00. You can check with Lucas the bartender.

sophie_relationship.speaker: Sophie
sophie_relationship.text: We broke up six months ago. It was... complicated. But we stayed professional. I still manage his exhibitions.

choices.text: Was there any tension between you?

sophie_tension.speaker: Sophie
sophie_tension.text: Honestly? Yes. He wanted to switch galleries. That would have ruined me. But I wouldn't... I could never hurt him.

start.speaker: Marc
start.text: Such a tragedy. Julien was my best friend since childhood. I'll help however I can.

choices.text: When did you last see Julien?

marc_last_seen.speaker: Marc
marc_last_seen.text: I stopped by the studio around 20:30 to discuss some accounts. Left at 21:00. Everything was fine.

choices.text: Your car was photographed outside the studio at 21:45
Your GPS shows you at the studio until 22:00

marc_car_caught.speaker: Marc
marc_car_caught.text: I... I may have stayed a bit longer. We had a lot to discuss. But I left before anything happened!

choices.text: Why did you lie about leaving at 21:00?

marc_gps_caught.speaker: Marc
marc_gps_caught.text: That... that must be wrong. These GPS things aren't always accurate, right?

choices.text: The car photo AND GPS both confirm it. Why are you lying?

marc_why_lie.speaker: Marc
marc_why_lie.text: Fine! Yes, I was there later. We had an argument about money. But when I left, he was alive! You have to believe me!

choices.text: Tell me about the life insurance policy

marc_insurance_confronted.speaker: Marc
marc_insurance_confronted.text: The insurance... How did you... That was Julien's idea! He wanted to protect the business! I didn't... I would never...

marc_business.speaker: Marc
marc_business.text: Great, mostly. Julien handled the creative side, I handled finances. We complemented each other perfectly.

marc_finances.speaker: Marc
marc_finances.text: Nothing serious. Just the usual business discussions. Every partnership has those.

resolution.arrest_narrative: Officers arrive at Marc Duval's apartment at dawn. When confronted with the evidence — his car at the scene, GPS placing him at the studio until 22:00, and the €500,000 life insurance policy — Marc breaks down. 'It wasn't supposed to happen like this,' he whispers as the handcuffs click shut.
resolution.evidence_summary: Marc Duval lied about leaving the studio at 21:00. Security photos and GPS data prove he was there until at least 22:00. A €500,000 life insurance policy naming Marc as sole beneficiary reveals the motive. His own words — 'We had an argument about money' — complete the picture.
resolution.epilogue: Sophie Martin takes over Julien's studio, turning it into a memorial gallery. His final exhibition, 'Shadows of Trust,' becomes his most celebrated work. Sometimes the most dangerous people are the ones we've known the longest.
